ot.description: The creation of the world and humanity; God rests on the seventh day.

psalm.description: A psalm praising God's glory revealed in creation and His perfect law.

nt.description: John the Baptist's ministry, the baptism of Jesus, and the beginning of His public ministry.

ot.description: The fall of man, Cain and Abel, and the generations from Adam to Noah.

nt.description: Jesus heals the paralytic, calls Levi, and teaches about the Sabbath.

ot.description: The story of Noah, the flood, and God's covenant symbolized by the rainbow.

psalm.description: A hymn celebrating God as Creator and Sustainer of life.

nt.description: Jesus heals on the Sabbath, appoints the twelve apostles, and faces opposition.

ot.description: God's covenant with Noah, the Tower of Babel, and the nations descended from Noah.

nt.description: Parables of the sower, the lamp, and the mustard seed; Jesus calms the storm.

ot.description: God calls Abram, makes a covenant with him, and promises descendants and land.

psalm.description: All creation is called to praise the Lord.

nt.description: Jesus heals a possessed man, a bleeding woman, and raises Jairus' daughter.
